answers.evidence:
Verified against the **real CDN artifacts** (`sql.js@1.10.3` `sql-wasm.js` + `sql-wasm.wasm`, downloaded from cdnjs) in `/tmp/sqljs-check/verify.js` — a browser-faithful `vm` sandbox where `window === globalThis` and the loader is evaluated as a top-level script (true `<script>` semantics), plus a node-path load of the same artifact. 14/14 checks pass:

| # | Check | Result |
|---|-------|--------|
| 1 | Real artifact defines `window.initSqlJs` as function | PASS |
| 2 | Real artifact never defines `window.sqlJs` (`typeof === 'undefined'`) | PASS |
| 3 | T93 **old** criterion `sqlJs: function` → **false FAIL** (the bug reproduced) | PASS |
| 4 | T93 **fixed** criterion `initSqlJs: function` → **PASS, zero app changes** | PASS |
| 5 | Full sandbox browser boot: `initSqlJs()` resolves, `window.SQL` populated | PASS |
| 6 | End-to-end SQLite: `CREATE TABLE` → `INSERT` → `SELECT` returns `[1,"sql.js"]` | PASS |
| 7 | Edge: loader 404 → fixed criterion **still fails** (fix does not mask real regressions) | PASS |
| 8 | Edge: init pending → `initSqlJs` already assertable | PASS |
| 9 | Edge: init pending → `SQL` not yet available (why the loader symbol is the right sync assert) | PASS |
| 10–13 | Edge: typo variants `sqljs`, `SqlJs`, `initSqlJS`, `Sqljs` correctly fail | PASS |
| 14 | Edge: `initSqlJs` idempotent (2nd call returns cached module) | PASS |

Key edge cases covered: **no masking** (a genuinely missing loader still FAILs the corrected criterion — the fix only kills false negatives, not real ones); **async timing** (loader symbol is synchronously assertable, `SQL` is not — asserting `SQL` at page load would reintroduce a false FAIL); **case/typo sensitivity** (only the exact real symbol passes); **vendor-ground-truth** (verified against the actual shipped artifact, not docs).

```
[PASS] artifact defines initSqlJs on window  (typeof window.initSqlJs === 'function')
[PASS] artifact never defines sqlJs          (typeof window.sqlJs === 'undefined')
[PASS] T93 OLD criterion (sqlJs: function) -> false FAIL (the bug)
[PASS] T93 FIXED criterion (initSqlJs: function) -> PASS, no app changes
...
totals: 14 passed, 0 failed
```
